##: The MSI is renamed to setup.msi_ so Scoop does not auto-extract it. It must stay in $dir so the uninstaller can find it.
description: Offline school report card system for Ugandan secondary schools. Builds report cards from teacher-entered marks with A-E grading, aggregates, division and automatic remarks.
notes: Runs fully offline. The whole school is stored in one local file with rotating backups.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to install"; break }
if (!(Test-Path $msi)) { error 'installer not found at $msi'; break }
if ($proc.ExitCode -ne 0) { error "msiexec install failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)"; break }
pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to uninstall"; break }
if (!(Test-Path $msi)) { warn 'installer missing; skipping msiexec uninstall'; break }
# 1605 = product not installed, 3010 = reboot required: both acceptable at uninstall
if ($proc.ExitCode -notin @(0, 1605, 3010)) { error "msiexec uninstall failed with exit code $($proc.ExitCode)"; break }
